c.title: $4,500 / 3br - Charming 3-Bed Dunbar Character Home with Large Private Backyard
c.description:
This charming 3-bedroom, 1.5-bathroom character home offers the opportunity to live in one of Vancouver's most desirable westside neighbourhoods. Filled with natural light, it features a large, private backyard, perfect for relaxing, gardening or entertaining.
Close to Crofton House School, St. George's School and Pacific Spirit Park, and just minutes from Dunbar Village shopping, cafés, golf courses and transit.

3 bedrooms, 1.5 bathrooms
Laundry on site
Off-street parking
Available October 1, 2026
$4,500/month
